scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Support to Small Growers' Collectives/ SHGs/ Cooperatives for Coffee Marketing
other_conditions: Applicants must belong to Small Growers' Collectives, Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Co‑operatives operating in traditional coffee‑growing states
Applicants must engage in marketing of clean (green bean) coffee only, under the name of the respective collective/SHG/co‑operative

Marketing must be conducted through recognized public auction platforms (e.g., Indian Coffee Trade Association), direct export, or recognized commodity exchanges that allow physical delivery of coffee
Applicants who have already received a subsidy for the same activity/component under the MIDH period are not eligible for another subsidy unless they represent new beneficiaries
benefits_summary: Subsidy of ₹4 per kilogram of clean (green bean) coffee is provided to eligible collectives.
documents_required: Prescribed application form for claim reimbursement
Sale note issued by the auctioneers or commodity exchange
